arb.vpnDisclosure_body: FuzeVPN yana amfani da sabis ɗin VPN na Android (VpnService) don ƙirƙirar ɓoyayyen rami tsakanin wannan na’ura da sabobin FuzeVPN.
arb.vpnDisclosure_dataBody: Yayin da VPN ke aiki, zirga-zirgar intanet ɗin manhajojinku, adiresoshin inda za a je da buƙatun DNS suna wucewa ta wannan rami don tura haɗinku, ko da FuzeVPN yana gudana a bayan fage.
arb.vpnDisclosure_statusBody: Manhajar tana amfani da matsayin haɗin, tsawon lokacinsa da yawan bayanan da aka tura don nuna haɗin VPN ɗinku. Kuna iya dakatar da shi a kowane lokaci.
arb.accountRestoration_title: Asusu ba ya samuwa na ɗan lokaci
arb.accountRestoration_message: An ajiye zaman shiganku. Ku sake gwadawa don dawo da asusunku; har yanzu kuna iya sarrafa haɗin VPN a nan.
arb.session_ending: Ana rufe zaman shiga: ana dakatar da VPN kuma ana tsaftacewa…
arb.session_stopFailed: Ba a tabbatar da rufe VPN ba. Ku sake gwadawa kafin ku sake shiga asusu.
arb.session_cleanupFailed: An dakatar da VPN, amma ba a tabbatar da share zaman shiga ba. Ku sake gwada tsaftacewa.
arb.auth_keysLocal: Maɓallan VPN ɗinku na sirri suna nan a wannan na’ura.
arb.form_passwordMin: Byte 8–72 na UTF-8. Wasu haruffa suna amfani da fiye da byte ɗaya.
arb.auth_requiredInformation: Ku ƙirƙiri asusunku cikin matakai uku.
arb.auth_consentRequired: Ana buƙatar amincewarku don ƙirƙirar asusu.
arb.validation_password: Kalmar sirri ta yi gajarta: aƙalla byte 8 na UTF-8.
arb.validation_passwordTooLong: Kalmar sirri ta yi tsawo: iyakar byte 72 na UTF-8.
arb.validation_phone: Yi amfani da tsarin ƙasa da ƙasa, misali +33612345678.
arb.validation_country: Yi amfani da lambar ƙasa mai haruffa biyu, misali FR.
arb.passwordReset_description: Shigar da adireshin imel na asusunku don neman hanyar haɗin sake saita kalmar sirri.
arb.connection_subtitle: Ku zaɓi wuri, sannan ku kunna VPN ɗinku.
arb.verification_title: Ku tabbatar da adireshin imel ɗinku
arb.verification_message: Ku tabbatar da adireshin imel ɗinku don amfani da VPN a wannan waya.
arb.migration_blocked: Canjin wuri yana buƙatar shiga tsakani daga sabar. Ku sake gwadawa daga baya ko ku tuntuɓi tallafi.
arb.status_authorizingDetail: Ku karɓi buƙatar Android don ba VPN izini.
arb.status_reconnectingDetail: An katse haɗin. VPN yana ƙoƙarin sake haɗawa.
arb.status_errorDetail: Ba a tabbatar da haɗin VPN ba. Ku sake gwadawa.
arb.status_idleDetail: Ku haɗa VPN don kare haɗinku.
arb.trust_note: Rufe manhajar ba ya katse VPN. Don katse shi, ku yi amfani da Katse haɗi.
arb.locations_none: Babu wurare da ake samu a yanzu.
arb.locations_lockedTunnel: Ku katse VPN don canza wuri.
arb.locations_lockedMigration: Ku jira canjin wuri ya kammala.
arb.devices_empty: Babu na’urar VPN da aka yi wa rajista tukuna.
arb.devices_firstConnection: Za a ƙara wayarku a haɗin farko.
arb.settings_subtitle: Zaɓuɓɓukanku da asusunku, duka a wuri ɗaya.
arb.settings_languageDescription: Harshen da kuka zaɓa ya shafi sanarwar VPN ma.
arb.settings_licensesDetail: Kayayyakin manhaja da ake amfani da su a cikin manhajar
arb.settings_licensesLegalese: Lambar tushe ta manhajar da sassanta na MPL-2.0: {url}
arb.settings_background: VPN yana ci gaba da aiki idan kun bar manhajar. Don katse shi, ku yi amfani da Katse haɗi a shafin Haɗi.
arb.dialog_removeCurrent: Wannan waya za ta katse haɗi da VPN kuma ta rasa damar shiga. Za a share bayanan haɗin VPN ɗinta bayan sabar ta tabbatar.
arb.dialog_removeOther: Za a soke damar shiga VPN ga “{name}”. Ba za a iya warware wannan ba.
arb.dialog_signOutMessage: VPN zai tsaya, kuma sai kun sake shiga asusu. Maɓallan VPN ɗinku da aka ɓoye za su kasance a wannan waya don haɗinku na gaba.

arb.protection_guideWhy: Wannan kariyar tana hana manhajoji amfani da intanet kai tsaye idan VPN ya katse. Ana saita ta a Android.
arb.protection_guideAlwaysOn: Android tana ci gaba da gudanar da sabis ɗin VPN kuma tana iya sake kunna shi bayan wayar ta sake farawa.
arb.protection_guideBlockTitle: Toshe haɗi ba tare da VPN ba
arb.protection_guideBlock: Wannan saitin yana hana zirga-zirga ketare VPN, har da lokacin da haɗin ya katse.
arb.protection_guideWarning: Idan an kunna wannan toshewar, intanet zai kasance a kashe har sai an haɗa VPN.
arb.protection_guideStep1: Ku buɗe saitunan VPN na Android ta maɓallin da ke ƙasa.
arb.protection_guideStep2: Ku buɗe zaɓuɓɓuka ta gunkin saituna da ke kusa da FuzeVPN.
arb.protection_guideStep3: Ku kunna VPN mai aiki koyaushe, sannan ku kunna Toshe haɗi ba tare da VPN ba, idan waɗannan zaɓuɓɓukan suna nan.
arb.protection_guideManufacturers: Sunaye sun bambanta daga waya zuwa waya. Idan ya zama dole, ku nemi VPN a Saituna, sau da yawa a ƙarƙashin Hanyar sadarwa da intanet.
arb.protection_guideDisable: A cikin waɗannan saitunan, ku kashe toshe haɗi ba tare da VPN ba don ba da damar shiga intanet ba tare da VPN ba. Ku kuma kashe VPN mai aiki koyaushe idan ba ku son Android ta sake kunna shi.
arb.protection_guideManual: Ku ne kuke zaɓar waɗannan saitunan a Android. FuzeVPN ba ya canza muku su.
